lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns extending from the post-gill region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity oriented orthogonally to the carinae, intersecting the primary blobs at regular intervals to form a coordinate-like matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges characterized by a sharp luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow on the ventral-facing edge, running longitudinally across the upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Truncation of the apex of the first dorsal fin, resulting in a flattened and irregular top margin instead of a natural point or curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached along the ventral surface and trailing the pectoral fin; artificial logo 'INDIAN OCEAN' superimposed in the bottom-left corner.
